optimizedDescription.value: ArchiveListEntry: lightweight index row for fast archive listing without per-entry manifest reads.

optimizedContext.value:
# ArchiveListEntry
## Rules
### Index entry fields
- Required: `name`, `archivedName`, `archivedAt`, `specIds`, `schemaName`, `schemaVersion`.
- Optional `archivedBy` only when `includeArchivedBy` set; else MUST NOT appear.
- MUST NOT include `artifacts` (use `get(name)`) or `workspaces` (derive from `specIds` prefix before `: `).
- Public name `ArchiveListEntry` replaces `ArchivedChangeIndexEntry` (deprecated alias OK).
### No manifest-only data
- MUST NOT require manifest-only fields (artifact maps, full history, type lists). Detail via `get(name)`.
## Constraints
- Read-only; no mutators. Intentionally incomplete vs `ArchivedChange`.
- `includeArchivedBy` is projection-only; index stores full payload.
